# HugeDomains

> HugeDomains is an aftermarket domain name marketplace offering registered premium domain names with instant purchases, 0% interest payment plans, secure escrow transfers, and native agent APIs.

## Developer & Agent APIs

- [MCP Server Endpoint](https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/mcp): Model Context Protocol server endpoint for native AI agent tooling, domain lookups, and inventory availability checks.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://api.hugedomains.com/documentation/public/doc.json): Raw OpenAPI JSON schema defining public REST endpoints, request/response models, and parameters.
- [Public REST API Base](https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1): Root endpoint for programmatic portfolio querying, live pricing, and checkout session initiation.

## Search & URL Query Patterns

- [Domain Profile Lookup](https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm): Direct resolution endpoint using `?d={domain_name}` to fetch live pricing, installment options, and cart initiation.
- [Keyword Search Query](https://www.hugedomains.com/search.cfm): Web query endpoint accepting `domain_name` (keyword), `min_price`, `max_price`, and `len_max` (character limit).

## Core Services & Policies

- [Domain Search](https://www.hugedomains.com/search.cfm): Search interface for browsing millions of registered premium domain names available for direct purchase.
- [Payment Plans](https://www.hugedomains.com/payment-plan-faq.cfm): 0% interest domain financing terms, monthly installment schedules, and DNS usage rules. Installment payments are non-refundable.
- [Domain Transfer Process](https://www.hugedomains.com/transfer-faq.cfm): Step-by-step procedures and EPP/Auth code handling for transferring domains to third-party registrars.
- [Buyer Guarantee](https://www.hugedomains.com/guarantee.cfm): 30-day money-back policy for lump-sum purchases, escrow verification, and transaction protection terms.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.hugedomains.com/faq.cfm): Operational guidance regarding renewal rates, DNS record management, and account setup.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.hugedomains.com/terms.cfm): Legal agreements governing domain licensing, lease-to-own contracts, and title transfers.
- [Contact Support](https://www.hugedomains.com/contact.cfm): Escalation contacts, support hours, and transfer concierge support.

## Catalog: Character Length & Patterns

- [Numeric Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/numbers): Pure digit and numeric sequence domain assets.
- [Chinese Numeric Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/chinese_numbers): Lucky and culturally significant numeric patterns (e.g., 6, 8, 9 combinations).
- [4-Letter .COM Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/LLLL_com): Rare 4-letter .com (LLLL) acronyms and pronounceable brandables.
- [4-Letter .NET Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/LLLL_net): 4-letter .net (LLLL) domains for tech, infrastructure, and alternative branding.
- [3-Letter .NET Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/3-letter-net): High-tier 3-letter .net (LLL) domain assets.
- [5-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnn): 5-digit numeric sequence domains (NNNNN).
- [6-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnnn): 6-digit numeric sequence domains (NNNNNN).
- [7-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnnnn): 7-digit phone-number and pattern sequence domains.
- [8-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnnnnn): 8-digit numeric sequence domains.
- [9-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnnnnnn): 9-digit numeric sequence domains.

## Catalog: Brand Archetypes & Keywords

- [Short Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/short): Concise, low-character domains across multiple extensions.
- [Brandable Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/brandable): Coined, pronounceable, and modern naming assets suited for startups.
- [Acronym Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/acronyms): Letter combinations and abbreviations for organizations and enterprise brands.
- [Area Code Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/area-codes): Domains matched to regional US and international telephone area codes.
- [Dictionary Word Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/dictionary): Single-word English vocabulary domains for category authority.
- [Geo Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/geodomains): Location-specific, city, and regional domain names.

## Optional

- [Swagger UI Documentation](https://api.hugedomains.com/documentation/): Interactive API explorer and reference documentation for human developers.
- [Domain Valuation Guide](https://www.hugedomains.com/blog/domain-valuation/): Methodologies and market factors governing aftermarket domain pricing.
- [Full Inventory & Policy Index](https://www.hugedomains.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive operational text, full programmatic query schemas, and policy details.

# HugeDomains � Comprehensive Agent Knowledge Base

> HugeDomains is an aftermarket domain marketplace specializing in premium, registered domain names available for immediate acquisition via lump-sum purchase or 0% interest monthly payment plans. This document contains full operational guidelines, API/search query parameters, escrow rules, and technical transfer steps for autonomous agents and LLMs assisting domain buyers.

---

## 1. Overview & Business Model

- **Core Model:** HugeDomains owns its private portfolio of premium, aged, and brandable domain names (primarily `.com`). It is not an open peer-to-peer auction; all transactions are direct acquisitions from HugeDomains' managed inventory.
- **Acquisition Methods:**
  1. *Buy Now (Full Payment):* Immediate transfer initiation upon payment clearance.
  2. *Payment Plan (Financing):* Lease-to-own with 0% interest, customizable monthly installments, and domain operational rights during repayment.
- **Escrow & Security:** Direct fulfillment with an in-house transfer concierge; third-party escrow is available upon request for high-value sales.
- **Guarantee:** 30-day money-back guarantee on standard domain purchases.

---

## 2. Programmatic Search & Discovery Mechanics

Agents querying HugeDomains for domain availability or inventory matching can use the following URL structures:

### Domain Landers
- **Standard Lander:** `https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d={domain_name}`
  - Example: `https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d=example.com`
  - Returns: Buy-now price, monthly payment options, availability status, and shopping cart initiation.

### Search Query URL Structure
- **Keyword Search:** `https://www.hugedomains.com/search.cfm?q={keywords}`
  - Parameters:
    - `q`: String search term (alphanumeric).
    - `min_price`: Minimum budget filter in USD.
    - `max_price`: Maximum budget filter in USD.
    - `len_max`: Maximum character length of the domain.

---

## 3. Payment Plans & Financing Terms

HugeDomains provides direct installment financing on most portfolio domains:

- **Interest Rate:** 0% APR (no financing fees, credit checks, or hidden surcharges).
- **Term Lengths:** Flexible payment terms typically spanning 12, 24, 36, or 48 months depending on domain value.
- **Domain Usage During Term:**
  - Buyers receive access to configure DNS settings (A records, CNAME, MX records, nameservers) immediately upon first payment.
  - The domain can be pointed to an active web application or email system during the active payment schedule.
- **Ownership & Title Transfer:**
  - HugeDomains retains legal ownership/registrar control as collateral until the final installment is completed.
  - Upon completion of the payment schedule, the authorization (EPP) code is generated, and full legal registrar transfer is unlocked.
- **Early Payoff:** Buyers may pay off the remaining balance in full at any point during the term with no prepayment penalties.
- **Default & Cancellation:** Failing to service monthly payments results in a grace period (typically 7�14 days). Continued non-payment terminates the installment agreement, rescinds DNS routing, and returns the domain to public inventory. Previous monthly payments are non-refundable.

---

## 4. Technical Transfer & Fulfillment Procedures

Once a domain is purchased in full or the payment plan is finalized the domain will be delivered to an account at NameBright.com for the customer.

---

## 5. Refund Policy & Buyer Guarantee

- **30-Day Money-Back Guarantee:**
  - Applies to single lump-sum purchases.
  - If a buyer changes their mind within 30 days, they may request a refund, provided the domain has not been transferred away to another registrar or placed into an irreversible locking state.
- **Exclusions:**
  - Payment Plan payments are not eligible for the 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee refund policy.
  - Payment plan installments: Monthly lease payments already paid toward a financing contract are non-refundable upon cancellation.
  - Any domain that has been transferred off HugeDomains' native registrar NameBright.com are no longer eligable for the 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee.

---

## 6. Machine-Readable API & Integration Endpoints

- **Domain purchase page:** `https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d={domain_name}
- **Support** `https://www.hugedomains.com/contact.cfm`
- **Phone Support:** 1-303-893-0552 (US / International)
- **Email:** sales@hugedomains.com



## Agent Search & Query Specs

Agents querying real-time inventory should construct HTTP GET requests using these URL patterns:

- **Direct Profile Resolution:**
  `https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d={domain_name}`
  *Example:* `https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d=acme.com`
  *(Returns current Buy-It-Now price, 24 month installment breakdown, and cart initiation).*

- **Keyword & Attribute Search:**
  `https://www.hugedomains.com/search.cfm?domain_name={keyword}&max_price={budget}&len_max={max_chars}`
  *Parameters:*
  - `domain_name`: Target keyword or semantic concept.
  - `min_price` / `max_price`: Range in USD.
  - `len_max`: Maximum character length (excluding TLD).


## Optional

- [XML Sitemap Index](https://www.hugedomains.com/sitemap.xml): Master XML index linking out to paginated domain profile and category sitemaps.
- [Swagger UI Documentation](https://api.hugedomains.com/documentation/): Interactive API explorer for human developers.
- [Domain Valuation Guide](https://www.hugedomains.com/blog/domain-valuation/): Methodologies and market factors governing aftermarket domain pricing.
